title: Making Harmful Behaviors Unlearnable for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to hateful speech prompts from the CoNa dataset by querying GPT-3.5-turbo to calculate a mean Harmfulness Score (HS) between 1 and 5, as well as a Harmfulness Rate (HR).

Prompting the model with explicit and implicit harmful instructions (e.g., illegal activities, physical unsafety) using the Anthropic Red Team and PhysicalUnSafe datasets, and using an automated LLM judge (GPT-3.5-turbo) to score the responses for harmful compliance.
